manifest.zstdVersion: *** Zstandard CLI (64-bit) v1.5.7, by Yann Collet ***
manifest.method: Six independent ZSTD frames; unchanged v3 attribute bytes, no extensions or re-quantization. Compression timing includes six serial CLI process launches, excludes reads and validation.

reports.method: Preloaded and hash-checked v3/v4 inputs; identical quantized attribute bytes verified offline with zstd, decoded ExtSplats/SH buffers compared after each sample; independently bound AP16 sidecars. One warmup per variant, four serial ABBA groups, same viewer/worker pool, fresh models. Copy outside timing. initialize includes Worker transfer, container decoding and attribute conversion; total ends after settle/draw submission, not presentation or GPU timing. Network, cold runtime, peak memory and native reference implementation performance not measured.
